notes.title: You're now a Docent
notes.text: 6 yeses for Baroque. At this point it's less a preference and more a relationship. A Wooded Landscape by Meindert Hobbema got the star. It's not hard to see why. When you love something, you say it's the light. We believe you. Next, try Art of Africa. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: The verdict, for now
notes.text: Met artist 8 keeps getting your approval. It may be time to admit you have a favorite. Plot twist: you started out all about Baroque, and lately it's Impressionism. People change. We now guess your reaction right 43% of the time. Don't let it go to your head. Or ours. Next, try Symbolism. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: A note on your looking
notes.text: Your most recent Love, A Wooded Landscape by Meindert Hobbema, fits the pattern of your Baroque picks. Met artist 8 is the artist you've responded to most consistently. Your taste is moving: earlier you favored Baroque; recently it's Impressionism. Next, try a little Ming dynasty China; you haven't seen any yet.
